name: Lower Dolpo Trek
alt_names: Phoksundo Lake and Dho Tarap Trek
sub_region: Dolpa District, Karnali Province; Shey-Phoksundo National Park

difficulty.notes: Remote loop with two passes above 5,000 m (Numa La approx. 5,190 m, Baga La approx. 5,070 m) crossed on consecutive days; mostly camping above Dho Tarap; flight-dependent access via Juphal.

duration_days.basis: Full trip Kathmandu-Kathmandu (approx. 13 trekking days Juphal-Juphal)
duration_days.notes: Loop Juphal - Dunai - Tarakot - Dho Tarap - Numa La - Baga La - Ringmo (Phoksundo) - Juphal is the standard; some operators run it in reverse or add Kathmandu sightseeing. Shorter Phoksundo-Lake-only out-and-back treks from Juphal also exist (approx. 8-10 days).

itinerary.notes: Restricted area permit processed by the agency via Department of Immigration.
Dunai altitude is quoted inconsistently by operators (2,030-2,850 m); approx. 2,140 m used here.
Dho Tarap given as 4,080-4,090 m by most sources.

itinerary.route: Rest and acclimatization at Dho Tarap
itinerary.notes: Monasteries of the Tarap valley (Buddhist and Bon).

itinerary.route: Dho Tarap - Numa La Base Camp
Cross Numa La (approx. 5,190 m) - Pelung Tang
Cross Baga La (approx. 5,070 m) - Dajok Tang

best_seasons.notes: NTB lists Mar-May and Sep-Oct as best season for Shey-Phoksundo National Park. Numa La and Baga La can be snowbound in winter and early spring.

permits.name: Lower Dolpo (Lower Dolpa) Restricted Area Permit
permits.fee: USD 20 per person per week; USD 5 per person per week beyond 1 week (official wording)
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; Thulibheri, Tripurasundari, Dolpo Buddha RM wards 1-3, Shey Phoksundo RM wards 8-9, Jagdulla, Mudkechula, Kaike

permits.name: Shey-Phoksundo National Park entry
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,500; under 10 free)
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals (route visits Ringmo / Phoksundo Lake inside the park)

permits.name: TIMS card (agency-issued)
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; Lower Dolpo Trek is on the NTB guide-and-TIMS route list

guide_requirements: Restricted area: permit only via a government-registered trekking agency with a licensed guide. Since 22 March 2026 solo trekkers can obtain restricted-area permits (previous two-person minimum removed), max 7 trekkers per guide, agency responsible for rescue. Lower Dolpo is on the NTB list of routes requiring a licensed guide and agency TIMS.

logistics.notes: Basic lodges/homestays in lower villages and at Ringmo; camping needed for the Numa La / Baga La section.

highlights: Phoksundo Lake, Nepal's deepest lake, and Phoksundo waterfall
Two high passes: Numa La and Baga La
Dho Tarap and the Tarap valley's Buddhist and Bon culture
risks: Altitude above 5,000 m on consecutive pass days
Snow on passes outside main season

acclimatization.notes: The Ringmo rest day comes after the high passes; Dho Tarap is the key pre-pass acclimatization stop.

unverified: Lower Dolpo RAP extension wording: NTB/DoI say USD 5 per week beyond 1 week; some operators say USD 5 per day.
Pass heights Numa La 5,190 m and Baga La 5,070 m come from operator itineraries (two agree); not confirmed by an official source.
Dunai altitude inconsistent across operators (2,030-2,850 m).
